ideas.title: Investigating the Use of Force by Federal Agents
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the use of force by federal agents, including the Border Patrol and ICE
ideas.angle: Excessive use of force and accountability
questions: What are the protocols for using force by federal agents?
How often do federal agents use excessive force?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose systemic issues within federal agencies and highlight the need for greater accountability and transparency. By analyzing public records and interviewing whistleblowers, we can shed light on the use of excessive force by federal agents and push for reforms.
